headline: SFG @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.03 at OAK 4.35, with a projected total of 8.38. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: SFG moved -0.68 runs while OAK moved +0.29, changing the projected margin by -0.97 runs. The projected total fell -0.39, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Adrian Houser has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Rafael Devers, Nick Kurtz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Bryce Eldridge because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
